grades: Middle school, high school and college students
notes: The site lists more than 10,000 Michigan members.
name: Michigan HOSA (Future Health Professionals)
what_you_do: Join a school chapter, compete in health skills events at one of nine regional conferences, and the top finishers go on to the state conference in April and then the international conference.
who_can_apply: Students interested in health care, through a school chapter. The site also says you can start a chapter.
pay_detail: Dues and fees not stated on the home page
duration: School year. State conference in April 2027 at the Grand Traverse Resort.
deadline_text: 2027 state conference is in April at the Grand Traverse Resort. International conference: June 22 to 25, 2027, Philadelphia. Regional dates are on the 26-27 calendar page.
how_to_apply: Ask your school health or CTE teacher about a chapter, or use the Join MI HOSA link on the site. Contact: hosa@mhc.org or (517) 347-8088.
